notes.glasses: Eyes must not be covered by frame; no reflections or tinted glasses allowed.
notes.smile: Strict neutral facial expression, mouth closed, facing camera centered.
notes.ears: Ears do not strictly have to be visible, but face contour from chin to hairline must be visible.
notes.shadows: Even illumination, no shadow behind ears, chin, or background.
notes.babyRules: Children aged 5 and under may have slight deviations. For infants under 1 year, head doesn't need to be straight or eyes open.
